claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap { kind: 'unlimited' }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring has no per-activation limit — it can be activated any number of times. ActivatedAbilityMechanics requires an ActivationResource whose cap must be one of: fixed, threshold_tiers, linear_per_level, proficiency_bonus, ability_modifier. None expresses 'unlimited.' Encoding with fixed:1 or any concrete cap would misrepresent the rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to give yourself the Invisible condition.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: permanent duration endsOn: 'wearer_bonus_action' (or DurationEndTrigger { kind: 'wearer_spends_bonus_action' })
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The invisibility ends when the wearer voluntarily spends a Bonus Action to dismiss it. The v4 lifecycle atom 'self_break' covers this concept, but the surface does not expose it. The permanent duration's endsOn only accepts 'dispel' | 'damage'; DurationEndTrigger covers externally-caused ends (attack roll, damage taken, etc.) but not a deliberate wearer-initiated dismissal. A new variant is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You remain Invisible until the ring is removed or until you take a Bonus Action to become visible again.
